name: How can I maximize storage in a small guest bathroom remodel?

mainEntity.name: How can I maximize storage in a small guest bathroom remodel?

acceptedAnswer.text: Start with a functional vanity that includes pull-out drawers or integrated organizer trays rather than open shelving, which can easily look cluttered. Installing a recessed medicine cabinet and a recessed shower niche gives guests dedicated space for toiletries without taking away room volume. Blue Lake Construction frequently incorporates linen cabinets, floating vanities, and built-in shelving into bathroom designs to optimize available square footage while maintaining clear clearances around toilets and doorways.
acceptedAnswer.description: Maximize storage by installing vanities with full-extension drawers, adding recessed medicine cabinets, and incorporating built-in shower niches into the framing.
